# the standing modifiers of the ideas that are done; none without the hold
DA_BG_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_done_cement NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_BG_idea_cement } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_BG_idea_cement duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_done_shovel NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_BG_idea_shovel } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_BG_idea_shovel duration = -1 }
	}

# the work on the benches is finished: its report gives what it gives

# one idea reaches the Board: one of those nobody has proposed yet. Called from the hidden event DA_Hehodovar_event.20 only: a random_list
# called from a button gives the same result every time.
DA_BG_draw_idea = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_BG_all_ideas_known = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_known_cement } }
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_known_cement
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_new_cement
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_known_shovel } }
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_known_shovel
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_new_shovel
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_known_chair } }
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_known_chair
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_new_chair
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_known_gate } }
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_known_gate
				set_country_flag = DA_BG_new_gate
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_known_cheese } }

				set_country_flag = DA_BG_new_cheese
			}
			10 = {

			10 = {

# the Thinkers' Party. Called from the hidden event DA_Hehodovar_event.20 (the rolls need an event).
# The cellar that was chosen is poured if the treasury covers it; otherwise the next one down.
DA_BG_hold_party = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_ale
	clr_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_reserve
	clr_country_flag = DA_BG_party_dry
	if = {
		limit = { DA_BG_all_ideas_known = yes }    # nothing left to propose: small beer, no bill, no sequel
		set_country_flag = DA_BG_party_dry
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { DA_BG_cellar_reserve = yes DA_BG_guildhall_at_tier_2 = yes treasury = 400 }
			add_treasury = -400
			set_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_reserve
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { DA_BG_cellar_ale = yes DA_BG_cellar_reserve = yes } treasury = 150 }
			add_treasury = -150
			set_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_ale
		}
		DA_BG_draw_idea = yes
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_ale has_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_reserve } }
			DA_BG_draw_idea = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_reserve }
			DA_BG_draw_idea = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_BG_guildhall_at_tier_3 = yes }
			DA_BG_draw_idea = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_ale }
			random_list = {
				15 = {
					random_list = {
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.30 days = 3 } }
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.31 days = 3 } }
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.32 days = 3 } }
					}
				}
				85 = { }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_poured_reserve }
			random_list = {
				35 = {
					random_list = {
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.30 days = 3 } }
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.31 days = 3 } }
						1 = { country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.32 days = 3 } }
					}
				}
				65 = { }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 4078 = { has_province_flag = DA_BG_stages_read } }
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.50 days = 20 }
			}
			75 = { }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_BG_party_months value = 60 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_BG_parties value = 1 }
	country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.21 }
}

# every month, for the owner of Hehodovar and for a country that still carries standing modifiers of the Guild
DA_BG_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_BG_guildhall_found = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_BG_standing_in_step = yes } }
			DA_BG_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_BG_guildhall_at_tier_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_BG_party_months value = 1 } }
				subtract_variable = { which = DA_BG_party_months value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_BG_party_months value = 1 } } DA_BG_party_month = yes }
				country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { DA_BG_any_work = yes }
				subtract_variable = { which = DA_BG_work_months value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_BG_work_months value = 1 } } }
					DA_BG_finish_work = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_BG_guildhall_at_tier_3 = yes
				4078 = { has_province_flag = DA_Hehodovar_exp3 }
				NOT = { DA_BG_stages_ruled = yes }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_BG_ruling_asked } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_BG_ruling_asked days = 60 } }    # asked once; again if the event could not fire
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_BG_ruling_asked
			country_event = { id = DA_Hehodovar_event.4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_BG_any_standing = yes }    # the hold is lost: what the Guild built for us lapses; a work on the benches waits
		DA_BG_remove_standing = yes
	}
}
